checks.name: targeted_experiment_plan_tests
checks.evidence: 58 passed; includes cohort/donor freeze, reserved external validation, animal-replication gating, wet-lab protocol gating, source authorization and original-method smoke tests

checks.name: real_data_smoke
checks.detail: Cohort freeze validation covered 434 records; GSE164441 mapped 20 libraries to 10 patients and GSE202379 mapped 59 libraries to 47 donors, while four GSE270583 libraries remained explicitly unresolved. GSE126848 was downloaded, checksum-verified and reserved as a 57-patient same-endpoint validation cohort with evaluation_status=not_evaluated. Public animal-replication search found no eligible NCD/HFD single-cell dataset with two independent animals per group. R MCL ran on the 60-node network; R CellChat ran on 31,922 mouse cells with database prefilter and stratified sampling; R scTenifoldKnk ran on 300 genes x 500 cells; PLIP ran on five local docking poses.
